claim: EFS One Zone file systems store data within a single Availability Zone. If all or part of that zone is lost or damaged, data stored in these file systems might be lost.
question: Where does an EFS One Zone file system store data, and what happens to the data if the Availability Zone is lost or damaged?

values.display: data that is stored in these types of file systems might be lost

qualifiers.condition: loss or damage to all or part of the Availability Zone
